text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Den norske Bank has increased its interest rate to business clients to 0.6 percent. Other banks are now considering whether to follow.
- Advertising income for commercial TV channels has risen by 18.4 percent so far this year.
- Several hundred forest fires have been reported during the last two weeks.

- Offshore services company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) reported a 53 percent surge in pre-tax profits in the first half from a year ago to $38.59 million. The results beat expectations and shares in PGS on the Oslo bourse closed 36 crowns up at 406 crowns per share.

- Nobody knows how much the Norwegian Federation of Trade Unions (LO) will spend to support the Labour Party in the campaign for September's election. Adviser Magne Nedregaard says LO will spend about one million crowns in addition to 2.5 million crowns granted by the LO congress.
